entries.description: An educational and job skill center on 52 acres of farmland offering a visitor's house called Star House, welcoming women with dependent children, and looking for new members.
entries.raw_text: WHO FARM INC 37010 SE Snuffin Rd, Estacada, OR 97023 (503)630-6728. Who farm is an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds. We have 52 acres of beautiful farmland, fields, hills, evergreens, a visitor's house in the magical woods called Star House. Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland with a city bus (NO 31) running within 5 miles of the farm. Visitors may stay max 2 weeks. We charge $4 per night's stay in Star House. Womyn with dependent children are welcome. Bring your own food. We have very rainy weather and lots of mud so sisters bring rain gear and goulashes! There's no electricity in Star House. We welcome: new members/residents. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 52 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive (trying to get back on our feet).
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it operates as an educational and growth center welcoming visitors; mailing address is a rural route so land is there; accepted groups includes Non-lesbian women based on 'womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds'; child groups included because 'Womyn with dependent children are welcome'.

entries.description: An educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and children on 60 acres, providing camping and cabins.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA, INC Box 97 Star Route 2, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Penthesileia, Inc is a non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children. A matrix between rural and urban. We have camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Group rentals available. No violence. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, leashed dogs, work exchanges. We have/are: 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is an educational community organization with rentals; Star Route mailing address implies land location; accepted groups includes Non-lesbian women and children explicitly listed.

entries.description: A community with food gardens, orchards, and animals, welcoming visitors by arrangement and nonlesbian women and children.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END Rt 3 Box 3645, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649. Our land embraces food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies. We're paying for our home by working various jobs in town. Visitor policy: visits must be prearranged by mail or phone. Land use fee: $2-$4 per day, food: $4 per day. Sometimes, for specific projects, work exchange may be arranged. No dogs!!! We welcome: girl children, boy babies, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 5 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land, women working in town.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it features a resident group of 5 lesbians working and living together on land; Rt mailing address means land is there; accepted groups includes nonlesbian women and children explicitly.

entries.description: A group of hardworking women and children living on land with permanent structures and camping space.
entries.raw_text: GOLDENWIMMIN 3502 Coyote Creek Rd, Wolf Creek, OR 97497 (503)866-2520. We are a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children. Write or call first. Absolutely no drop ins. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children. We have/are: 6 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because a group of women and children live together on land; street address implies land location; accepted groups includes Non-lesbian women based on general directory context and children explicitly.

entries.description: A feminist retreat on 23 acres in Southern Oregon offering workshops, cabins, and camping for women and children.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. A feminist retreat on forested land in Southern OR. We plan summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women - workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. We have a main house and several women-built cabins for sleeping and many secluded spots for camping. The main house has electricity, hot water and a shower. Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $1-3/day to our land support fund. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 5-10 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity (outdoor toilet), camping space, woods, farmland, women living/working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it describes itself explicitly as 'a feminist retreat'; PO box mailing address means land address fields are left blank, with land location stated as 'Southern OR'; accepted groups includes girl children and lesbians.

entries.description: A single woman living on 16 acres of undeveloped land, welcoming female visitors for short stays.
entries.raw_text: MULLEINSONG PO Box 302, Applegate, OR 97530. Single woman living on basically undeveloped land. Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for some work. Please write ahead of time. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 16 acres, camping space, woods, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned/occupied by a single woman ('1 lesbian'); PO box means land street address is blank, land city inferred from mailing city; accepted groups includes girl children.

entries.description: A residential community with a community center listed under an editor's note stating these groups do not have land per se.
entries.raw_text: EDITOR S NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, but we wanted to include them for your information. THE PAGODA COMMUNITY 207 Coastal Hwy-LC, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a residential community with a community center where members can stay for limited visits. Membership is $10-$20/mo. We currently have two cottages available for 1 year lease. We welcome: new members/residents (we rent cottages on a monthly basis only), girl children, nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only). We have/are: about 15 lesbians, small community on ocean, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Not a listing because it falls under the editor's note 'These groups don't have land, per se'.

entries.description: A guest house for and by women in Key West with accommodations, pool, and hot tub.
entries.raw_text: ELLIE'S NEST 1414 Newton St-LC, Key West, FL 33040 (305)296-5757. Key West's only guest house for and by women. Our individually decorated rooms (after famous women) all have baths, air conditioning and TV. We have a pool, large hot tub and sundecks. We welcome: new guests, girl and boy children over 9 years (others by prior arrangement), lesbians, nonlesbian women who understand. We have/are: 3 lesbians and up to 14 guests, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is 'Key West's only guest house for and by women'; street address implies land/location; accepted groups includes nonlesbian women and children.

entries.description: A single woman living in a large house near a river, welcoming various guests including men.
entries.raw_text: RIVER MOST WILD c/o Bettylou Guyton, PO Box 6-337, Ridge Manor, FL 33525 (904)583-4560. I live alone. The house is large, there is an upstairs with private bath and accommodations for 4 or 6. Kitchen is shared. I have canoes, tubes, and a whirl-pool (hot tub) and a game room. House is luxurious/outdoors rustic. A river is 20' from the front door. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs (outside please due to indoor cat). I have: housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned/occupied by a single woman ('I live alone'); PO box means land street address is blank; accepted groups includes men ('males') and children.
